rows.note: Use 最後 as the all-purpose choice for something final or last in a sequence, including the last syllable of a word or utterance.

example.english: This is the ultimate, final episode in the whole series.
example.traditional: 呢個係成個系列嘅最後一集。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 hai6 sing4 go3 hai6 lit6 ge3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 zaap6

rows.note: Use 極致 for the highest attainable degree or an exceptionally extreme quality, especially in phrases such as 極致嘅享受.

example.english: Soaking in a hot spring is the ultimate enjoyment.
example.traditional: 浸溫泉係一種極致嘅享受。
example.jyutping: zam3 wan1 cyun4 hai6 jat1 zung2 gik6 zi3 ge3 hoeng2 sau6

rows.note: Use 最遠 specifically when ultimate means the most distant in space, range, or remoteness.

example.english: This is the ultimate point we can reach.
example.traditional: 呢度係我哋可以去到最遠嘅地方。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 dou3 zeoi3 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1
